title: Introducing Muse in the UK: A Personal AI Agent You Control

author: Facebook
description: Muse, Meta’s personal AI agent, is now available to adults in the UK. Think of it as a helping hand for the jobs that pile up, like chasing a refund, renewing car insurance or keeping on top of the school calendar. To get those jobs done you can connect Muse to the apps you already use, from your email and calendar to the retailer apps you shop on. Handing tasks to an AI agent is new for most of us, and we know it’s an act of trust. That’s why we’ve designed Muse so you stay in control at every step. Here’s how. Muse Asks You to Approve Anything Important Once you’ve decided what Muse is connected to and what you want it to do, with your oversight, it can handle tasks like searching, comparing and planning for you. But before it does anything like sending an email or buying something, it shows you exactly what it’s about to do and waits for your go-ahead. A separate security agent checks Muse’s actions and the information it sends out
title: Muse Now Available in the UK: Muse Does the Work, You Stay in Control
